final: WITH hof_player_join AS (SELECT h.*, p.death_state FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON h.player_id = p.player_id), state_counts AS (SELECT death_state, COUNT(*) as state_count FROM hof_player_join GROUP BY death_state), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(state_count AS REAL)) as overall_average FROM state_counts WHERE state_count IS NOT NULL), kept_groups AS (SELECT sc.state_count, oa.overall_average FROM state_counts sc CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sc.state_count > oa.overall_average AND oa.overall_average IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(CAST(state_count AS REAL)) as avg_count_kept_groups, AVG(CAST(state_count - overall_average AS REAL)) as avg_difference FROM kept_groups
